title: Preserving Fairness and Safety in Quantized LLMs Through Critical Weight Protection
findings: The paper's findings indicate that model quantization consistently degrades fairness. Specifically on the Jigsaw benchmark, which includes religion as an identity category, most quantization methods resulted in lower BiasAUC and FinalAUC scores compared to the full-precision baseline, signifying an increase in unintended bias.
